    y:f32[32,128,1] = div x 128.0:f32[]
    z:f32[32,128,128] = sub q t
    ba:f32[32,128,1] = add y 9.999999747378752e-06:f32[]
    bb:f32[32,128,1] = sqrt ba
    bc:f32[32,128,128] = div z bb
    bd:f32[1,1,128] = broadcast_in_dim[broadcast_dimensions=(2,)] l
    be:f32[32,128,128] = mul bc bd
    bf:f32[1,1,128] = broadcast_in_dim[broadcast_dimensions=(2,)] k
    bg:f32[32,128,128] = add be bf
    bh:f32[32,128,512] = dot_general[
      dimension_numbers=(([2], [0]), ([], []))
      preferred_element_type=float32
    ] bg n
    bi:f32[1,1,512] = broadcast_in_dim[broadcast_dimensions=(2,)] m
    bj:f32[32,128,512] = add bh bi
    bk:f32[32,128,512] = mul 0.5:f32[] bj
    bl:f32[32,128,512] = neg bj
    bm:f32[32,128,512] = mul bl 0.7071067690849304:f32[]
    bn:f32[32,128,512] = erfc bm
    bo:f32[32,128,512] = mul bk bn
    bp:f32[32,128,512] = copy bo
    bq:f32[32,128,128] = dot_general[
      dimension_numbers=(([2], [0]), ([], []))
      preferred_element_type=float32
    ] bp p
    br:f32[1,1,128] = broadcast_in_dim[broadcast_dimensions=(2,)] o
    bs:f32[32,128,128] = add bq br
    bt:f32[32,128,128] = add q bs
  in (bt,) }
